resources.string: Type the address you open Tunarr Lineup at in a browser: the Lineup server (Docker, Node or the desktop app), not Tunarr itself. For example http://192.168.1.50:3000. Without http:// and a port, port 3000 is assumed.
Couldn\'t reach the Lineup server at %1$s (%2$s). Check the address, that the server is running, and that this device is on the same network.
Exports can\'t be saved in the Android app. Open the desk in a browser to export.
